w1.title: What should your agent do?
w1.subtitle: Pick the closest fit. You can change every detail on the next step.
w1.industryHint: Tailors the examples and placeholders you see next.
w1.empty: No templates are available right now.

w1.premiumHint: Uses the Premium voice stack (1.5 credits per minute).

bestFor.afterhours: Any business with a forwarded line

examples.plumbing: We are a residential plumbing company covering the West Island. Drain cleaning, burst pipes, water heaters and bathroom renovations. We run a 24-hour emergency line.
examples.dental: We are a family dental clinic in Laval. We do check-ups, cleanings, fillings, crowns and emergency toothache appointments. Two dentists, one hygienist, open six days a week.
examples.auto: We are an independent garage doing maintenance, brakes, tyres and pre-purchase inspections on most makes. Courtesy car by arrangement.
examples.legal: We are a two-lawyer family law practice downtown. Divorce, custody and mediation. First consultation is thirty minutes and is paid.
examples.salon: We are a hair salon with four stylists. Cuts, colour, balayage and blowouts. Walk-ins when we can, but almost everything is by appointment.
examples.real_estate: We are a residential real estate team covering the South Shore. Listings, buyer representation and free home evaluations.
examples.restaurant: We are a forty-seat bistro. Lunch and dinner, closed Mondays. Reservations for parties up to eight; larger groups are arranged with the manager.
examples.generic: Describe what your business does, who you serve, and what makes a call worth taking.
